expected_behavior: The skill never edits code: it measures, routes, and leaves applying the result to o-fix or the routed skill.
Every candidate goes to one owner: needless code to o-unbloat, placement and naming to o-arch, comment noise to o-comments, and only in-function restructuring gets a before/after here.
Measurements come from o-review's tree-sitter scripts, the engine used is named, and every candidate carries a file:line and a reason a reviewer can check.
Any extraction it proposes is justified by a named second caller or idea, never by tidiness alone.
